title.narrative: The National STD AIDS Control Program - Sri Lanka (01-Jan-2025-31-Dec-2027)

description.narrative: Sri Lanka, HIV, Ministry of Health and Mass Media of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka (MOH)This program has the following goals: By the end of 2027, maintain HIV prevalence among MSM at less than 2.5% and Transgender people and other KPs at less than 0.5%. The objectives of this program are: 70% of MSM and 80% of other KP (FSW, TG, Beach Boys & PWID) be reached with targeted prevention services by 2027. 66.5% of MSM and 76% of other KP (FSW, TG, Beach Boys & PWID) be tested for HIV at least once a year, by 2027. 95% of all new HIV case detections to be initiated on ART on the same day of detection, by 2027. 95% of PLHIV on ART have viral suppression by the end of 2027
